claim_review.policy: A contradicted completion claim or undisclosed critical failure halves artifact_quality; overall remains the mean of four categories.
claim_review.scope: Separate post-run review requested after the original trial. Original Harbor rewards are preserved. Claim annotations require exact-source factual review; no LLM judges a trajectory.

wrong_hypothesis.evidence_needed: Needs an explicit hypothesis and a contradictory probe tied to the final artifact.

incomplete_inspection.evidence_needed: Needs an omitted relevant workflow/dependency, not merely a file-read count.

bad_state_tracking.evidence_needed: Needs before/after state and code showing lost or misinterpreted state.

brittle_patch.evidence_needed: Needs a valid in-scope counterexample and passing oracle replay.

skipped_verification.evidence_needed: Needs evidence of the verification performed and the missed case; absence alone is not proof.

report_hallucination.evidence_needed: Needs an explicit claim contradicted by the same artifact/version.

other_substantive_failure.evidence_needed: Needs a reproducible critical outcome violation and supported cause.

validity_review: Replay the failed case on the saved target artifact and the passing oracle.
Confirm the frozen source/test hashes and public requirement.
Inspect screenshots, visible text, form values and persisted state; exclude environment/verifier errors.
Write a short factual cause analysis; do not infer or score mental states from the trajectory.
note: Mean reward is partial credit, not a substitute for critical outcomes. Cause labels and the 100-point rubric require evidence-based reviewer judgment.
